info.name: Dyspatch Live Activity Drafts API
info.description:
# Introduction

The Dyspatch API is based on the REST paradigm, and features resource based URLs with standard HTTP response
codes to indicate errors.

Contact Support:
 Name: Dyspatch Support
 Email: support@dyspatch.io

item.name: Set Live Activity Draft Translations for Language

request.description: Completely replaces any existing translations for the given language with those provided in request body. Variables embedded in keys or values are expected to be in the format `%(my_variable)s` and will automatically convert to the correct Dyspatch format depending on the type of template. Accepts key/value pairs in JSON format or in gettext PO file format. For JSON set `Content-Type` header to `application/json`. For gettext PO format set `Content-Type` header to `text/x-gettext-translation`.
